let audioCtx,timer,note=0;const melody=[523.25,659.25,783.99,659.25,587.33,698.46,880,698.46,659.25,783.99,1046.5,783.99,587.33,698.46,523.25,0];const sound=document.querySelector('#sound');function playNote(){if(!audioCtx)return;const f=melody[note++%melody.length];if(f){const osc=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();osc.type='sine';osc.frequency.value=f;g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,audioCtx.currentTime);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.065,audioCtx.currentTime+.03);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audioCtx.currentTime+.75);osc.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);osc.start();osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+.8)}}function stopMusic(){clearInterval(timer);timer=null;if(audioCtx){audioCtx.close();audioCtx=null}sound.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');sound.textContent='♫ Увімкнути мелодію'}sound.onclick=async()=>{if(timer){stopMusic();return}try{audioCtx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();await audioCtx.resume();playNote();timer=setInterval(playNote,450);sound.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');sound.textContent='Ⅱ Вимкнути мелодію'}catch(e){stopMusic();sound.textContent='Мелодія недоступна'}};document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&timer)stopMusic()});
